title: Release Linux CI Authority
objective: Replace provisional host Linux release packaging with architecture-selected glibc-floor baseline-to-SEA candidates and publish validated readiness and receipt evidence

handoff.summary: Integrated the independently reviewed Linux CI producer authority. Candidate tags now build both SEAs inside the architecture-selected glibc-floor baseline, package only receipt-bound candidates, publish readiness reports, and require the complete named readiness-check ratchet before release assembly.
risks: Source policy is approved, but final x64 and arm64 all-input builds remain downstream artifact proofs on their native runners.
next_steps: Run the exact frozen release commit through both native Linux baseline builders and retain archive, sidecar, readiness, and ABI receipts.
